svg.title: Figure 5-1. SM-TOY-AUTH as a UML state machine (WP-W-05)
svg.desc: UML state machine of SM-TOY-AUTH: T1 NOT_ALLOWED to ALLOWED (partly). T1a NOT_ALLOWED to ENGAGE_PENDING (partly). T1b ENGAGE_PENDING to ALLOWED (partly). T1c ENGAGE_PENDING to NOT_ALLOWED (partly). T8 NOT_ALLOWED to NOT_ALLOWED (partly). T2 ALLOWED to NOT_ALLOWED (implemented). T3 ALLOWED to NOT_ALLOWED (implemented). T4 ALLOWED to NOT_ALLOWED (partly). T5 ALLOWED to NOT_ALLOWED (partly). T6 ALLOWED to NOT_ALLOWED (not assessed). T6a ALLOWED to NOT_ALLOWED (implemented). T7 any to NOT_ALLOWED (implemented). T9 ALLOWED to NOT_ALLOWED (not implemented). T10a ALLOWED to NOT_ALLOWED (partly). T10b ALLOWED to NOT_ALLOWED (implemented). T10c ALLOWED to NOT_ALLOWED (partly). T10d ALLOWED to NOT_ALLOWED (not implemented). T10e ALLOWED to NOT_ALLOWED (not implemented). T11 ALLOWED to NOT_ALLOWED (implemented). T12 ALLOWED to NOT_ALLOWED (not implemented). T13 ALLOWED to NOT_ALLOWED (partly). T14 ALLOWED to NOT_ALLOWED (partly). T15 ALLOWED to NOT_ALLOWED (not implemented).
svg.text: Figure 5-1 · SM-TOY-AUTH as a UML state machine
Toyota authority (controls_allowed): 3 states, 23 transitions; 6 implemented, 11 partly, 5 not implemented
status as WP-W-05 §5 gives it, from the SWSRs each transition realises
Transitions (the record is normative; WP-W-05 §5.2 has them in full)
0x1D2 valid [CRUISE_ACTIVE 0→1 and rx_checks_allow_engagement() (every RX check valid; reference build also no TX-rate block); reference …
0x1D2 valid [CRUISE_ACTIVE 0→1, rx_checks_allow_engagement(), CRUISE_ACTIVE = 0 received since the safety mode was set, heartbeat …
safety task (100 Hz) [heartbeat engaged = 1 within 1 s of the edge, and rx_checks_allow_engagement()] / set, close the window
safety task, 0x1D2 or any RX [1 s passed without heartbeat engaged = 1; or CRUISE_ACTIVE = 0; or brake rising, or pressed while moving; or an …
0x1D2 valid [CRUISE_ACTIVE held 1; or 0→1 with rx_checks_allow_engagement() false; or (reference build) 0→1 before CRUISE_ACTIVE = 0 has …
any RX [brake rising, or pressed while moving] / clear
RX of checked message [checksum, quality flag or counter invalid; reference build: or a frame of another length (ATC-25), the entry then invalid until a …
safety_tick (100 Hz safety task) [any RX check lagging (5 periods), below 10 Hz, or invalid] / clear
1 Hz tick [heartbeat engaged=0 for 3 consecutive ticks] / clear
safety task: engaged-mismatch check [heartbeat engaged=0 for 30 safety tasks (0.3 s) since the first such heartbeat while authority was granted] / …
safety mode set (0xdc, heartbeat loss, harness change) / clear
TX frame rejected by a content check / clear, reason
safety task: heartbeat check [no SoC heartbeat for > 0.3 s in a car mode] / clear; siren 3 s when authority was granted (panda c33343b)
safety task: command freshness check [no accepted 0x2E4/0x343 for 50/100 ms (accepted: passed by the TX hook; supervision starts at the first …
0x1D2 / 0x1D3 [CRUISE_ACTIVE while MAIN_ON is off for > 150 ms] / clear
TX frame over the per-ID rate budget [3 rejected frames in one 125 ms half-window] / clear, report txRateExceeded
safety task: driver torque check [|driver torque| > T_ovr for > t_ovr] / clear (steering_disengage)
SPI error [more than N_spi errors within 100 ms] / clear, report
car-side CAN bus-off or persistent TX failure / clear, report
safety task: forwarding supervision [relay driven and no camera-side frame for > t_fwd, or camera-side bus-off] / clear all, release relay
Generated by fig_w05_uml_states.py from state-machines/sm-toy-auth.yaml; nothing is hand-listed but the positions of the states.

g.text: Terms: ALLOWED the envelope's authority state with controls_allowed = 1 (NOT_ALLOWED: 0), WP-W-05 §5.2 · ATC-nn architecture target-state change of WP-W-03 §10 · CAN controller area network: the vehicle's data bus ·

ID identifier · RX receive · SM-nn safety mechanism (TSC §6) · SoC system on chip: the comma device's main processor, running openpilot (QM) · SPI serial peripheral interface (the link between SoC and MCU) · SS-nn

safe state (FSC §6): SS-L lateral, SS-G longitudinal, SS-S envelope silent · SWSR-nn software safety requirement (WP-W-02) · TX transmit · UML Unified Modeling Language (OMG): state machine, sequence and component
diagrams · WP-nn work product, e.g. WP-C-04; the letter is its area (M management, C concept, S system, H hardware, W software, V validation, P processes, A analyses, O operation, K safety case)
